# py-skia-canvas

> Standalone Python Canvas library using the original skia-canvas 3.0.8 Rust/Skia core.

## Install / 安装

Published on production PyPI: py-skia-canvas==0.1.0a18 (alpha prerelease).
已发布到正式 PyPI，当前已验收版本为 0.1.0a18（alpha 预发行版）。

```shell
python -m pip install --index-url https://pypi.org/simple/ --only-binary=:all: py-skia-canvas==0.1.0a18
```

Requires CPython 3.13. Accepted wheels: Windows AMD64; Linux glibc 2.28+ x86_64.
Import: py_skia_canvas. No Node/npm, Rust toolchain, or skia-python runtime dependency.
Offscreen rendering automatically falls back to CPU without a usable GPU.
App/Window presentation requires GPU and desktop support.

## Historical descriptions

The PyPI 0.1.0a18 description is the original upload-time README. Its claim that
PyPI publication has not happened is outdated; both wheels are published.
GitHub documentation updates do not change existing PyPI release metadata.
Use the explicit pinned installation command and current repository documentation.
